paragraphs.text: Included: Airport – hotel transfer with guide · Private São Paulo city tour · Breakfast

blocks.text: After breakfast, a private city tour of São Paulo’s most representative landmarks

paragraphs.text: Day 2 · After breakfast, a private city tour of São Paulo’s most representative landmarks, beginning at Ibirapuera Park, the city’s main green space, with the Obelisk, the Monument to the Flags and works by the architect Oscar Niemeyer, including the Museum of Contemporary Art (MAC) and the Oca. Continue through elegant Jardins, with the distinctive Hotel Unique and the traditional Church of Nossa Senhora do Brasil, to Vila Madalena and the colourful, ever-changing graffiti of Beco do Batman.
